theater_trial005402_dialogue03_0010:
With her Assist Skill, "Bewitching Beauty" Aphrodite
raises damage dealt and wind damage dealt
for all of her units.
theater_trial005402_dialogue03_0020:
Her Passive Skill also inflicts Damage Taken Up
on enemies when she attacks, greatly boosting
the damage your allies deal.
theater_trial005402_dialogue03_0030: Combine the two characters and fight freely!
theater_trial005501_dialogue01_0010:
"Dainsleif" Hogni Ragnar is an adventurer
who greatly empowers himself with his Special.
theater_trial005501_dialogue01_0020:
Combine it with his skills and normal attacks
to gain the upper hand in battle.
theater_trial005501_dialogue02_0010:
"Dainsleif" Hogni Ragnar's Special raises
his own wind damage dealt and movement speed.
theater_trial005501_dialogue02_0020:
His normal attacks also cover a wide area
and hit enemies many times.
theater_trial005501_dialogue03_0010:
"Dainsleif" Hogni Ragnar's Skill 2 has a narrow
range, but it comes out fast and hits hard.
theater_trial005501_dialogue03_0020:
It always lands a critical on enemies with
Movement Speed Down, so apply that with
Skill 1 to get the most out of it.
theater_trial005601_dialogue01_0010:
"Hildsleif" Hedin is an adventurer whose skills
grow stronger against bound enemies.
theater_trial005601_dialogue01_0020:
Bind enemies with his Special or other moves,
then hit them with skills to gain the upper
hand in battle.
theater_trial005601_dialogue02_0020:
Skill 2 grants Regen to all of his units,
and also Stuns the enemy if it is bound.
theater_trial005601_dialogue03_0010:
"Hildsleif" Hedin's Special damages enemies
while raising thunder damage dealt
for all of his units.
theater_trial005601_dialogue03_0020:
After inflicting Bind and Damage Taken Up,
it places a field effect that deals continuous
damage and lowers Endurance.
theater_trial011001_dialogue01_0010:
"Goddess of Chastity" Artemis is an adventurer
who grows stronger the higher she keeps her HP.
theater_trial011001_dialogue01_0020:
Her skills and Special restore her HP and grant
Shields, with various extra effects depending
on how much HP she has left.
theater_trial011001_dialogue02_0010:
"Goddess of Chastity" Artemis's Special restores
her HP, and when her current HP is high,
her crit rate and damage rise.
theater_trial011001_dialogue02_0020:
Skill 1 can be used twice in a row and grants
her a Shield. Keep her HP high with her Special
and skills to get the most out of her.
theater_trial011001_dialogue03_0010:
"Divinity Unleashed" Hestia raises thunder
damage dealt for her units while restoring
their HP.
theater_trial011001_dialogue03_0020:
She boosts "Goddess of Chastity" Artemis's
damage, and her healing makes it easier
to keep Artemis's HP high.
theater_trial011001_dialogue03_0030: Combine the two characters and fight freely!
theater_trial011003_dialogue01_0010:
"Crescent Moon Goddess" Artemis is an adventurer
defined by her shifting skills: after using
certain skills, she can follow up with another.
theater_trial011003_dialogue01_0020:
Her normal attack and skill damage also rise
when her HP falls below a set ratio, so she
can turn the tide with a counterattack.
theater_trial011003_dialogue02_0010:
Use "Crescent Moon Goddess" Artemis's Skill 1,
then use Skill 1 again to trigger a follow-up
attack that deals even heavier damage.
theater_trial011003_dialogue02_0020:
Her Special consumes a large chunk of her HP
to Shield her units, and also raises their
Endurance and skill damage dealt.
theater_trial011003_dialogue03_0010:
"Storyteller" Hermes's Assist Skill raises
skill damage dealt for his units and grants
them Shields.
theater_trial011003_dialogue03_0020:
His Passive Skill raises fire and skill damage
dealt, and raises crit damage when his HP
falls below a set ratio.
theater_trial011003_dialogue03_0030: Combine the two characters and fight freely!
theater_Anya_quest_04_01_01: Meeen min min min min min min min—

theater_Anya_quest_04_01_05:

so perhaps it isn't all bad...
theater_Anya_quest_04_01_06:
But we staff must never let the customers see
us in such a sorry state. Clear the mind,
and the fire itself is cool—
theater_Anya_quest_04_01_08:

If you're done shopping, hurry up and get
back to work-nya!

You handle the rest-nya!

Uh, hello? That's obviously not okay.

Water off a duck's back. Common sense off

S-stop that this instant!!

Funya?!

she's kinda lacking in the sex appeal—
theater_Anya_quest_04_02_07:

theater_Anya_quest_04_02_08:

theater_Anya_quest_04_02_11:
I know-nya! You guys should wear swimsuits too!

theater_Anya_quest_04_02_13: What'd you say, you dumb cat?!
theater_Anya_quest_04_02_14:
Nyahahahaha! That's right, that's right!
Everybody into swimsuits-nya!
theater_Anya_quest_04_02_17:
This is so ridiculous it's giving me a headache...

theater_Anya_quest_04_02_18:

theater_Anya_quest_04_02_20:
Syr?! Wha...?!

theater_Anya_quest_04_02_21:
Nyahaha! That's our Syr-nya!
C'mon, everybody into swimsuits and cool off~!
theater_Anya_quest_04_03_01:
Syr, what are you thinking?!

theater_Anya_quest_04_03_02: Hehe, I just thought it might be kind of fun.
theater_Anya_quest_04_03_03:
There you go again... Look, if you say

theater_Anya_quest_04_03_05:
See? Now they're totally fired up.

theater_Anya_quest_04_03_06:
Nyahaha! Now we're talking-nya!
Hey, you guys! Wanna see us in swimsuits?!
theater_Anya_quest_04_03_09:
See, the customers have spoken-nya!
Ryu! Hurry up and get into a swimsuit too!
theater_Anya_quest_04_03_10:
Whoo-hoo! Syr in a swimsuit'd be amazing, but

theater_Anya_quest_04_03_12:

theater_Anya_quest_04_03_13:

NYAAAH?! M-M-Mom?!

theater_Anya_quest_04_03_29:
What d'you think you're doing,

theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_01:
Meanwhile, as Loki's "plan" for the doodling
girl, the Daydreamer, was being prepared—
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_03:
We're about to climb one crazy-high peak:
makin' that magical girl world a reality!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_04:
Go in half-hearted, and we'll let the maestro
down in a flash. We might even make her
throw that wonderful "world" away!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_05:
No way, that can't happen! I'll do anything
if it'll cheer her up!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_07:
Then what d'ya think's the most crucial part
of bringin' the maestro's "world" to life?
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_08:
Hmmmmmm...
A super-amazing spell to beat the Dark Apostles?
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_09:
Sure, that's important too. Takin' down villains
with a finishin' move is one of the big
highlights of any magical girl story!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_10:
The maestro's "Magical Sunrise," powered by
two magical girls' friendship, is gonna be
one red-hot finisher!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_11:
—But the one absolute rule of magical girls
is the transformation!! Nail that scene,
and the crowd'll love ya forever!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_12:
Yeah! Chanting magic words and turning into

theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_13:
Right? Becomin' the wonderful self ya dreamed of
and grabbin' the best future—everybody gets
that magical girl wish to transform.
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_14:
So, Tiona—no, Magical Girl Sunny Smile!
I've got yer costume all ready!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_15:
We're trainin' till we nail the most magical,
lovely transformation scene ever!!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_16:
Yeaaaaah!
Shine bright, light! Sparkle, smiles—
Magical Change, transform!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_17:
—Now! Come on out, Tiona! Time to show off
Magical Girl Sunny Smile in all her glory!!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_18:
Wha?! I'm not dressed yet!
I can't change that fast!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_19:
Change that slow and it's just changin' clothes!
There ain't a speck of transformation in it!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_20:
A magical girl transformation goes flash,
then zap-zap-zap, the costume snaps on!
It's supposed to be cool!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_21:
But this outfit's totally different from
what I usually wear...
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_22:
Shaddup! Ya wanna make that kid's dream

theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_23:
Whoa, whoa?! Loki?!
I'm gonna trip—!!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_01_24:
Y-ya idiot! Don't come this way!!
Nwaaaaaaaah!!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_01:
—Here is the item you requested.

Brooch"...?
theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_02:
It's a magical girl's secret item,
gifted by a fairy from the Land of Light!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_03:
...Ooooooh!! It's all cute,

theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_04:
As requested, I also built in a function

instantly.

Yeah, now I won't eat any more of Tiona's
headbutts. Ya never fail me in a pinch,
Perseus.

So—why did you need a magic item

theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_08:
It's all Lord Hermes's fault for accepting
the request, but after back-to-back
all-nighters, my skin is at its limit...
theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_09:
Now, now. One look at a magical girl's
lovely-pretty transformation scene, and that
fatigue'll be blown clean away!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_10:
Tiona! Show us what ya got!
It's Magical Girl Sunny Smile's big debut!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_11:
Yeah! Here I gooooo!!
Shine bright, light! Sparkle, smiles—
theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_12: Magical Girl Sunny Smile has arrived!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_13: Whoa, I really transformed! So cooool!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_15:
Huh? What's wrong, Loki?

theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_16:
The costume's fine. It's super-duper cute.

A magical girl transformation's gotta have

Ahh... Now that you mention it, her drawings

But this just flashes and—poof...
Hey, Asfi. Can't ya do somethin' about this?

Even if you ask me to... The transformation

theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_21:
Gaaah! That ain't it! Presentation, presentation!

theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_22:
Effects... I see. It's likely possible, but...
if it's urgent, I'd need to pull an all-nighter

theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_23:
That's Perseus for ya—that name ain't just

"It's to grant a girl's wish. Asfi will work

theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_27:
I wanna show that kid ASAP!
Fast as ya can, Perseus!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_30:
Made it in one night! That's Perseus for ya.

theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_31:
That's... quite enough of that.

theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_32:
You got it! Okay, Tiona—

theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_34: Magical Girl Sunny Smile has arrived!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_35:
Amaaaaaazing! It's sparkly and cute—

theater_Tiona_quest_03_02_37:
Though these dazzling effects were born from

?! Don't tell me... there's still a flaw...?

Ah, nah, nah, the brooch is perfect!
The problem's—Tiona.

Yup. You... still don't get the true

Okay, here I gooooo!!

Right! Tiona, gimme an intro line that

Um, um, please look at me as a magical girl!

That's misleadin' in every possible way!

—Oh? So you're mocking my pure, innocent,

theater_Tiona_quest_03_03_20:
Gah! Tione?!

theater_Tiona_quest_03_03_21:
Honestly... All the racket made me come check.

theater_Tiona_quest_03_03_22:
Ahaha, sorry... But I just don't get "cute."

Overthinking stuff again, even though you're

theater_Tiona_quest_03_03_33:

theater_Tiona_quest_03_03_34:
I'll cast a smile spell on you☆
Magical Change, Sunny Smile!!
theater_Tiona_quest_03_03_36:

theater_Tiona_quest_03_03_37:
Magical Girl Sunny Smile!

theater_Tione_quest_03_01_28:

theater_Tione_quest_03_01_29:

theater_Tione_quest_03_02_01:
I am "someone" who once belonged to the Hera

theater_Tione_quest_03_02_02:
Clinging only to my hatred for the men of

theater_Tione_quest_03_02_04:
...Tione.

theater_Tione_quest_03_02_09:
